title: Repeat-Lateness Allowance: Marketplace Orders Late-Delivery Compensation
content:
**Schedule.** The repeat-lateness allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation counts the late-delivery credits recorded as earned on the buyer's Loop+ membership, each credit counting when the whole calendar months from its earning date to the handling date are fewer than the repeat-lateness window of 12 months: at least the frequent-lateness count of 3 such credits earns the frequent repeat-lateness allowance of USD 4.00; at least the occasional-lateness count of 1 but fewer than 3 earns the occasional repeat-lateness allowance of USD 2.00; fewer earn no repeat-lateness allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## What is counted

Entries on the buyer's Loop+ Membership ledger recording a credit earned whose credit type is late delivery. A credit counts when the whole calendar months from its earning date to the handling date are fewer than 12; a credit earned 11 whole months and some days before the handling date counts, one earned 12 whole months or more before does not.

## Allowance by count

| Late-delivery credits counted | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 2.00 |
| 2 | 2.00 |
| 3 | 4.00 |
| 4 or more | 4.00 |

### Hypothetical case

On a hypothetical handling date of 20 September, a buyer's Loop+ ledger shows late-delivery credits earned on 5 January of the same year, 30 October of the previous year and 19 September of the previous year. The first two are fewer than 12 whole months back and count; the third is 12 whole months back and does not. Two credits count, so the allowance is USD 2.00. The dates are example inputs.
